name: Shimmering Frond
summary: In the Oracle Glade, a plant from beyond the Great Sea casts a twisting, shimmering aura. Its fronds belong to a species native to the Swamp of Sorrows.

sections.title: A Specimen from Afar
sections.body: Near the Oracle Glade, a radiant plant grows among the trees. Its aura pulses, and its fronds shimmer in the woodland light. Denalan tends planters beside Lake Al'Ameth. He recognizes the leaves as a species from the Swamp of Sorrows in the Eastern Kingdoms. How seeds from that distant marsh crossed the Great Sea and took root on Teldrassil remains a mystery. Denalan is growing specimens in his own soil to study them.

faq.q: Where does the Shimmering Frond come from?
aliases: where do i get shimmering frond
faq.answer: A strange plant in the Oracle Glade on Teldrassil bears the Shimmering Frond. Its leaves shimmer with a twisting, pulsing radiance in the forest light.

faq.q: Who is interested in the Shimmering Frond?
faq.answer: Denalan, a night elf naturalist beside Lake Al'Ameth, wants to study the frond. He researches strange plants taking root across Teldrassil.

faq.q: What makes this plant so unusual on Teldrassil?
faq.answer: The plant comes from the Swamp of Sorrows in the Eastern Kingdoms, far across the Great Sea. It is unexpected on Teldrassil, since it is native to neither Kalimdor nor the World Tree.

faq.q: What happens after giving the frond to Denalan?
aliases: what does denalan do with it
faq.answer: Denalan plants the specimen in his planters beside Lake Al'Ameth. He studies its rapid growth and exotic properties.

angles.text: As a druid, you may find a marsh plant thriving on Teldrassil's newly raised branches a curious anomaly.
As an herbalist, you can appreciate the resilience it took for a Swamp of Sorrows plant to cross the ocean and thrive in foreign soil.
